event.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Found Guilty of 191 Murders
event.canonical_title: Kenyan Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Found Guilty of 191 Murders
event.summary: A Kenyan court has found Paul Mackenzie, a self-proclaimed preacher, and his associates responsible for the murders of 191 people, primarily children, linked to a starvation cult. The verdict was delivered on Monday, with Mackenzie having denied the charges, claiming he did not order the victims to starve in order to 'meet Jesus.'

timeline.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Paul Mackenzie Sentenced to 200 Years for Mass Murders
timeline.summary: Paul Mackenzie, the leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult, has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult. He was convicted for inciting his followers to starve themselves to death as part of a belief that they would meet Jesus. The court's decision follows a trial that included 28 co-defendants, and Mackenzie plans to appeal.
